name: Linux runtime (Ubuntu 26.04 LTS)
note: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS arm64 runtime for DroidDeck, built by tools/ubuntu in Droid-Deck/DroidDeck (PR #1733); rc2 adds libxcb-keysyms1 so the DD-Turnip driver loads (PR #1773); rc3 adds libva-drm2 and libva-x11-2 so Proton's media decoder loads and game cutscenes play (PR #1823); rc4 adds liblzo2-2 so FEX's unsquashfs runs and the x86-64 Steam client starts (PR #1825); rc5 carries Mesa's Zink fix so PowerVR GPUs keep colour textures in colour (PR #2287); rc6 makes Zink give back the memory an idle client freed, so Steam's UI behind a game holds about 250 MiB less (PR #3320), refreshes every slot sharing a rebuilt sampler view (PR #2178), and carries the desktop fixes from PRs #3151, #3173 and #3231. Its Kubuntu Plasma desktop pack is ubuntu-r1-rc6-desktop.tar.zst in the same release, named inside the runtime at usr/share/droiddeck/desktop-pack.json. Release candidate: only test builds of PR #1733 read this file.
